text_sanskrit: विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः । निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति ॥ २-७१ ॥
itrans: vihAya kAmAnyaH sarvAnpumA.nshcharati niHspR^ihaH . nirmamo niraha~NkAraH sa shAntimadhigachChati .. 2-71 ..
translation: He who, loosed from all the (prohibited) wishes, from the . fancy of being the (absolute) master and the (absolute) agent, experiences all the objects of desire) without any attachment,-- he is the man, he attains to perfect bliss.
